plugins.name: napkin-math
plugins.description: Back-of-the-envelope estimates with stated assumptions and honest ranges, plus a sanity check for numbers other people quote at you.

skills.name: estimate
skills.description: Make a back-of-the-envelope estimate with stated assumptions and a range. Use when the user asks roughly how much, how many, how long or how big something is, asks for a Fermi estimate, a ballpark, or napkin math, or runs /napkin-math:estimate <question>.
skills.description_zh: 对数量、成本、时长或规模做费米式粗略估算，明确假设并给出范围，适用于快速数量级判断。

skills.name: sanity-check
skills.description: Check whether a number someone quoted is plausible, using a quick independent estimate. Use when the user asks "does this number make sense", "is this plausible", "sanity check this figure", pastes a claim with a number in it and asks if it holds up, or runs /napkin-math:sanity-check <claim>.
skills.description_zh: 通过独立快速估算检查引用数字是否合理，评估包含数字的说法能否成立。
